query: INSERT INTO project_tools (project_id, server_id, tool_id, enabled) SELECT ps.project_id, t.server_id, t.id, $3 FROM mcp_tools t JOIN project_mcp_servers ps ON ps.server_id = t.server_id AND ps.project_id = $1 WHERE t.id = ANY($2::uuid[]) ON CONFLICT (project_id, tool_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, updated_at = now()
